name: Ability Opto-Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ability Opto-Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, manufacturing, and sale of optical lens in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides optical lens products, including scanners, projectors, digital cameras, digital video recorders, multi-function printers, cell phone cameras, laptops, tablets, IP-cameras, monitors, automotive lens, etc.; and CCM/NB products, as well as lens for automotive, digital surveillance, special, professional, and other applications.
